# `PageSnapshot`

**Kind:** class  
**Module/package:** `models`  
**SDK:** `pdfdancer-client-typescript 3.0.0`

Represents a snapshot of a single page in a PDF document.
Contains the page reference and all elements on that page.

## Declaration

```typescript
class PageSnapshot
```
